title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Fish, Auto Sell, Full Progresses +More
features:
This Fishy Hub script for Heavyweight Fishing uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift, covering fishing, gear, bosses, progression, world, and settings. Its core is a pull-bar lock that holds the bar inside the game’s damage window on RenderStepped, with optional humanized wobble and brief gaps that drop a tick without risking the fish. Fishing also includes auto cast, stuck-line recovery, auto perfect slams, auto charge release, and auto rhythm hits on the A/S/D lanes. Gear tools handle best-rod equipping plus rod craft, buy, and awaken buttons, along with best-bait equipping and bait restocking that avoids crafted boss-summon baits. Selling includes favorites/weight/name protection and a filter that blocks selling while protected fish remain, plus a force-sell option. Boss tools auto-enter off cooldown with optional teleport and difficulty choice, and PvP can auto-queue. Progression covers gacha rolls, quest and daily claims, skill upgrades, code redemption, and AFK toggling. World tools scan the map for prompts, spawns, bosses, and secret-rod spots for teleporting, while movement adds walk/jump overrides, fly, and noclip. A live status panel shows fight state, bar position, bag usage, rod, bait, boss readiness, and currency, with theme/config saving and full unload cleanup.
